entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: The undead lich parun of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica, overthrown by gorgons and later revived and betrayed.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild of elves, outcasts and undead legions united by Svogthir.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where the Golgari Swarm exists.

entities.name: Savra vod Savo
entities.description: An elf who freed Svogthir, built him a new body, then betrayed him and took leadership of the Golgari.

entities.name: Sisters of Stone Death
entities.description: Five gorgons who overthrew Svogthir and sealed him in a tomb.

entities.name: Svogthos
entities.description: The ancient tomb in which Svogthir was sealed.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact proposed by Azor that ended the war between the guilds.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Proposer of the Guildpact; first to sign.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: A parun who signed the Guildpact second.

entities.name: Cisarzim
entities.description: The Gruul parun whose torso became part of Svogthir's body.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Simic guildmaster who allies with Svogthir and plans to use Project Kraj.

entities.name: Project Kraj
entities.description: Simic project meant to wipe Ravnica clean, which destroyed Vig's lab.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: A spirit who possessed Savra's body and overpowered Svogthir's mind.

events.summary: As parun, Svogthir signs the Guildpact third, after Azor and Razia, and helps convince the forces of chaos to sign.
events.quote: Svogthir was instrumental in convincing the forces of chaos to become signatories of the pact.

events.summary: Svogthir uses necromancy to become a lich and builds his body from the remains of powerful individuals, including Cisarzim's torso.
events.quote: surviving through his mastery of necromancy

events.summary: The five gorgons known as the Sisters of Stone Death overthrow Svogthir; he kills two, but the others rot his body and seal him in the tomb Svogthos.
events.quote: Svogthir was overthrown by five gorgons

events.summary: At the Guildpact's Decamillennial anniversary, Savra frees Svogthir and builds him a new body, which he uses to defeat the Sisters, killing two more.
events.quote: She freed Svogthir from his tomb and constructed a new body for him

events.summary: Savra betrays Svogthir, takes control of his body, cuts off his head, consumes his essence, and mounts his skull on her staff.
events.quote: cutting off his head, and consuming his essence to empower herself

events.summary: After Szadek murders Savra, Svogthir's spirit takes over her corpse and allies with Momir Vig to use Project Kraj.
events.quote: Svogthir's spirit took over the treacherous elf 's corpse

events.summary: Agrus Kos overpowers Svogthir's mind and kills Vig, then Kraj destroys Vig's lab with Svogthir inside; his fate is unknown.
events.quote: His fate after this is unknown

relations.note: He was the guild's parun for thousands of years.
relations.quote: was the parun of the Golgari Swarm on the plane of Ravnica

relations.note: Savra cut off his head after betraying him (though his spirit survived).

relations.quote: When Szadek betrayed and murdered Savra

relations.note: They allied to wipe Ravnica clean.
relations.quote: He made an alliance with the Simic guildmaster Momir Vig
